spans.s:
m. (-ब्दः)
1 A cloud.
2 A year.
3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
4 The name of a mountain.
E.
अप् water, प changed to ब, and द what gives; or अब to preserve, &c. and दन् Uṇādi affix; hence the word is also written अब्द.

n. (-तं)
A century.
E.
अब्द, and शत a hundred.

n. (-स्रं)
A thousand years.
E.
अब्द, सहस a thousand.

n. (-र्द्धं)
A half year.
E.
अब्द, and अर्द्ध half.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Annual, yearly.
E.
अब्द and ठन् aff.

n. (-र्गं)
A fortress surrounded by a moat or lake.
E.
अप् water, and दुर्ग fort.
